payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each start i, search k from 1 upward until s[i]==s[i+k]==s[i+2k], set nearest valid right endpoint; then suffix-min to count intervals containing any such triple.
payload.rationale: The solution brute-force searches for a triple per start index, pruning further search on first success, which aligns with branch-and-bound search. Other subtypes (two-pointers, sliding window, BFS) not used.
